title: Rig Relay Child Session Receipt v1
description: Content-light receipt record for a completed child session. Derived from Rig's Receipt vocabulary. No raw prompts, model outputs, source code, diffs, stdout/stderr bodies, secrets, tokens, API keys, raw receipts, or raw private paths.

child_session_id.description: Identifier of the child session this receipt belongs to.

lane_id.description: Optional lane identifier (e.g. fleet slot) for multi-lane sessions.

status.description: Completion status of the child session.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the child session started.

ended_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the child session ended. Null if not yet ended.

total_calls.description: Total number of tool calls made during the child session.

tool_counts.description: Tool call counts for the child session.

validation_status.description: Validation status of the child session's outputs.

sha256.description: SHA256 content hash of the artifact.

artifact_refs.description: Content-light artifact references produced by the child session.

progress_event_refs.description: References (SHA256) to progress events associated with this child session.

warnings.description: Human-readable warnings about the receipt or its data.

content_light_guarantee.description: Guarantee that the record contains no raw content.
